audit.proof_assessment: v9 HIGH is not faithful to these bytes. D7 already treats associated leases in released|cancelled|expired as no-ops when bound to a terminal receipt or UnusedCompareComponentProofV1 hash, allows only reconciliation-hold -> released in the same CAS, forbids reopening terminal leases, and is the sole reservation-hold and lease-hold exit after D3/D4/D6. D6 still parks any lease already in reconciliation-hold; D6U remains the unused offered|queued CAS; D2/D4 cannot exit lease-hold. Criterion holds on the supplied slice.
residual_risks: Compare arm lease-only moves (offered|queued cancel, claimed -> reconciliation-hold) while the parent stays held are implied by the non-compare-reservation exception rather than named D-rows; only D6U states that pairing explicitly.
D7 no-op must not bump a terminal lease revision, or later bound proofs can desync.
claimed -> released still needs the terminal receipt to bind the lease's segment/manifest/job; D-rows say this-segment, the lease state machine does not.
Reservation expiresAt still has no positive D-code; expiry is fail-closed only.
In-memory fixtures still cannot prove crash-safe CAS or durable D7 recovery.
